card.name: Inside drug names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: Early parts of drug names in lists of drugs, such as the first pieces of trimethoprim, desipramine, vancomycin, or the N of N-acetylprocainamide. It also fires on the comma after the first drug in a regimen.

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: Opening pieces of a longer drug name that is not yet finished.

modes.label: Comma in a drug combination
modes.description: A comma after a drug name that begins a list of drugs used together.
modes.example: A three-drug regimen consisting of rifampin<<,>> isoniazid, and pyraz

modes.description: The N before -acetyl in a metabolite name following a parent drug.
